shortDescription: Library mod: gives any pawn randomly rolled, hidden-until-discovered titan traits and materials, with naming, inheritance, visuals, light, ability AI and player settings. Content mods define the traits.
body:
## Purpose
Library mod for a later dungeon mod. Gives any pawn (animal, humanlike, mech) a set of rolled traits and a material. Content mods define the traits; this mod handles storage, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, visuals, light, materials, ability AI and hiding of undiscovered traits.

## Status
- Phase 1 (tested): traits, titan hediff, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, debug actions.
- Visuals, materials (run #28), light (run #29), mod settings (tabs since build 29, not yet seen in game).
- Phase 3 step 1, ability AI: tested run #31. Tamed firebreather holding fire next to colonists is vanilla FireSpew's friendly-in-cone rule, by design.
- Lead-in discovery: tested run #34, works.
- **Phase 3 step 2, hiding undiscovered traits (builds 40–43, reviewed at 42, not yet tested).**
- Phase 3 remaining: Biotech humanlike birth inheritance, diet traits, optional VRE gene compat.

## Ability AI (Source/TitanAI.cs)
- Postfix on Pawn_JobTracker.DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob runs JobGiver_TitanAbilities when the constant tree gave nothing (every 30 ticks). Result attributed to the constant tree root so saved jobs load.
- Guards: titan, spawned, awake, not downed/burning/drafted, not a player colonist, not in a non-aggro mental state, not already casting. Setting `abilityAI`.
- Order: trait `aiThinkTree`s; offensive trait abilities at the current enemy; self-targeted non-offensive trait abilities. All through vanilla AICanTargetNow.
- No constant think tree, no ability AI.

## Discovery of ability traits
- Normal: Hediff_Titan.Notify_PawnUsedVerb when the ability resolves.
- Lead-in: prefix+postfix on Ability.Notify_StartedCasting wraps this cast's new preCastActions so the trait is revealed when the visible effect starts (FireSpew flames play 17 ticks before resolving and can be cancelled).
- Gap: world-target abilities cast from a caravan don't reveal.

## Hiding undiscovered traits (Source/TitanHiding.cs)
- While StatsReportUtility.DrawStatsReport(Rect, Thing) draws a titan with any hidden trait (prefix/finalizer, main thread, plain static `cardPawn`):
  - Hediff_Titan.CurStage returns `cardStage`, built from discovered traits + material only.
  - Hediffs granted only by hidden traits return a null stage (postfix on Hediff.CurStage getter, set built per draw).
  - Capacities are marked dirty before and after; stat caches for the pawn cleared before and after. So the card's values and explanations act as if hidden traits don't exist, and gameplay recomputes real values.
- Not hidden: pain and bleed totals (warmed real first), effects from hidden hediffs' comps, hidden hediff classes overriding CurStage without base, and capacity values in the health tab.
- Ability gizmos: postfix on Ability.GizmosVisible hides abilities granted only by undiscovered traits. AI still casts them. With dev gizmos on, non-colonist pawns still show them as dev gizmos (vanilla).
- Info card rows are cached by vanilla when the card opens; a discovery while it's open shows after reopening.
- BuildStage signature is now BuildStage(bool discoveredOnly = false).

## Mod settings (TitanSettings, `TitanFrameworkMod.Settings`)
Tabs: Lights and effects / Traits / Materials, reset button bottom right.
- Lights and effects: lightsEnabled, lightFollowCells (1), lightRadiusFactor, effectsEnabled.
- Traits: inheritChanceFactor, discoveryMessages, abilityAI.
- Materials: materialArmorFactor (50%), materialDamageStrength, fireWeaknessStrength, butcherYieldPerBodySize (40), smallVolumeMultiplier (10), materialMarketValue.

## TitanTraitDef (XML: `<TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef>`)
- Generation: commonality, pointCost, exclusionTags, tags, race filters.
- Discovery: visible, discoverWhen (Manual, UsesGrantedVerb, UsesGrantedAbility, Attacks, TakesDamage, Dies), discoveryMessage.
- Naming: namePrefix, nameSuffix, nameOrder. Inheritance: heritable, inheritChance.
- Effects: stage, hediffs (give them becomeVisible=false stages), abilities, aiThinkTree, traitClass.
- Visuals: overlays, flames, effecters, glow.

## Harmony patches (18)
BestKindLabel; DoBirthSpawn and CompHatcher.Hatch prefix/finalizer; TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn; DropBloodFilth/DropBloodSmear; MakeCorpse; Corpse.IngestibleNow; Pawn.ButcherProducts; Pawn_JobTracker.DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob; Ability.Notify_StartedCasting prefix+postfix; StatsReportUtility.DrawStatsReport prefix+finalizer; Hediff.CurStage getter postfix; Ability.GizmosVisible postfix.

## Debug actions ("Titan Framework")
Add trait…, Roll traits…, Set material…, Discover all traits, Clear titan.

## Example content (Defs/Examples + Patches/TF_ExampleMaterials.xml): remove both together before publishing
Flaming, Venomous, Ironhide, Of the Deep, Brittle, Irradiated (Uranium), Firebreather (Biotech).
